1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

content.text:
playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
  cookie-get <name>           get a specific cookie by name
  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie
  cookie-clear                clear all cookies
  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs
  localstorage-get <key>      get a localstorage item by key
  localstorage-set <key> <value> set a localstorage item
  localstorage-delete <key>   delete a localstorage item
  localstorage-clear          clear all localstorage
  sessionstorage-list         list all sessionstorage key-value pairs
  sessionstorage-get <key>    get a sessionstorage item by key
  sessionstorage-set <key> <value> set a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-delete <key> delete a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-clear        clear all sessionstorage

Network:
  requests                    list all network requests since loading the page. each request is numbered for use with the `request` command.
  request <index>             show full details (headers, body, response) of a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-headers <index>     print only the request headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-body <index>        print only the request body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-headers <index>    print only the response headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-body <index>       print the response body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command. textual bodies are inlined; binary bodies are saved to a file and the path is printed.
  route <pattern>             mock network requests matching a url pattern
  route-list                  list all active network routes
  unroute [pattern]           remove routes matching a pattern (or all routes)
  network-state-set <state>   set the browser network state to online or offline

DevTools:
  console [min-level]         list console messages
  run-code [code]             run playwright code snippet

  video-hide-actions          stop annotating actions performed on the page
  show                        show playwright dashboard
  pause-at <location>         run the test up to a specific location and pause there
  resume                      resume the test execution
  step-over                   step over the next call in the test
  generate-locator <target>   generate a playwright locator for the given element
  highlight [target]          show (or with --hide, remove) a highlight overlay for an element; `--hide` without a target hides all page highlights.

Install:

  install-browser [browser]   install browser

Browser sessions:

Global options:

content.text:
The user re-sent the same request. I'm mid-build. Continue testing the game, improve visuals/combat, verify. Let me reload and test gameplay interactions, check screenshot of combat.

Let me think about quality. Current screenshot looks decent but the characters look a bit simplistic, and there's no melee feel. I should improve:
- The scene is dark and moody, good Ragnarök vibe.
- Add more depth (fog, embers, brazier).
- Boss fight, 3 waves.
- Mobile touch controls.
- Music via WebAudio.

Need to test actual combat: enemies approach, attack, health. Let me reload and run through with keyboard hold to check that waves progress and boss fight works. Also verify performance.

Potential bug: enemy death filter is weird:
```
enemies=enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead||particles.some(p=>Math.abs(p.x-e.x)<10));enemies=enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead);
```
First filter then second removes dead immediately. Fine but pointless; simplify. Also boss death triggers endGame after 1.6s via setTimeout while mode remains play, and round===3 so no transition. During that 1.6 sec, enemies array empty fine.

Wave progression: if round<3 and enemies.length===0 → beginWave(round+1). For boss, round becomes 3 so no. Good.

Attack hitbox: `Math.sign(e.x-player.x)===player.face` — if enemy exactly overlapping sign 0, no hit. Fine.

Player attack only hits once per swing per enemy via hitSwing flag; reset when attack<=0. Good.

Enemy attack: e.wind>0 then when reaches 0, attack=.24, leap=130. Then `if(e.attack>0){e.attack-=dt;if(e.attack<(.14)... && Math.abs(e.x-player.x)<e.leap && player.ground)hitPlayer(...)}`. Because once attack < .14 it remains so for multiple frames until 0 → player invuln prevents repeats anyway. But this means hit occurs ~0.1s after attack started. Fine.

But e.attack continues to decrease after damage; no lunge movement. Could add a lunge. Also boss should have more varied attacks (shockwave). Might add a ground slam projectile for boss.

Also enemy AI currently allows enemy to walk into player overlapping, fine.

Need to check visuals at combat. Let me reload and screenshot after some seconds. Use keydown ArrowRight and J.

Also check UI overlay's start after death.

Let me test in browser with run-code maybe easier: use playwright-cli eval to inspect globals? Globals are in IIFE, not exposed. I can test via screenshots.

Let me reload then click start, wait a couple seconds, press J repeatedly, screenshot.

I should add a favicon to avoid console 404 noise. Add inline data URI favicon.

Let me also consider adding:
- Combo counter / health pickups?
- Rage meter fills and burst.
- Boss telegraphs and shockwave.
- Camera shake, hitstop.
- Blood/ice particles.
- Better player sprite with cape physics.
- Ambient audio (drone + drums) — music is subtle; add war drums to feel Ragnarök. Implement heartbeat drum pattern via oscillator/noise.

The request: "juego en 2D al estilo god of war con música y temática como en los videojuegos ragnarok". So Norse theme, Kratos-like warrior, axe combat, epic music. I should make it feel more God of War: brutal melee, axe throws? Add axe throw mechanic maybe too much. Could add "Furia" (Spartan Rage analog). Already.

Improvements worth doing:
1. Visual polish — layered mountains, runestones, embers, fog, moon, aurora, better characters, shadows.
2. Combat juice — hitstop, screen shake, particles, damage numbers? Rune slashes.
3. Boss with AoE ice shockwave.
4. Music with drums + low drone.
5. Add pause overlay properly (already label).
6. Responsive touch.
7. Intro overlay look.

Let me first test current gameplay.

const compact=innerHeight<470||innerWidth<700;
const by=compact?176:72;

content.text:
Add slash trail arc in drawPlayer. Insert after axe restore before final ctx.restore? Current end:
```
ctx.restore();ctx.restore();}
```
The last restore ends the transform, so add before. We need the arc rotated with body but not with axe. Add after axe ctx.restore():

```
if(p.attack>0){const q=1-p.attack/.34;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.5*Math.sin(Math.PI*q);ctx.strokeStyle='#d9fff7';ctx.shadowColor='#a9f1e8';ctx.shadowBlur=18;ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(12,-45,52,-1.5+q*2.6, -.5+q*2.6);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
```
Tune: swipe in front. Player faces +x after transform. Arc centered at (10,-45), angles -1.4 to 0.6? During swing q from 0→1. A crescent that sweeps downward. Use start=-1.6+q*1.6, end=-0.7+q*1.6 with radius 58. Alpha sin(pi q). Nice.

Also add small speed lines when dodge: during dodge spawn afterimages? Could draw translucent silhouette copies. Hard. Add particles at start already.

Let's insert.

Bug: arc end angle -.6+q*2.1 may be less than start? start -1.7+q*2.1 → end - start = 1.1, fine.

Now adjust boss size h? Fine.

Check syntax. Also remove debug/test hooks soon, but still need to test boss after changes + mobile.

Let's also expose better debug for a full game run? Not needed; we validated mechanics.

Remaining concerns:
1. The game may be too dark. Screenshots are moody but readable. Good.
2. Music composition: drone + pad + drums. Drums every 1.35s with double beat. Might sound plodding. Add occasional horn. Fine.
3. Audio on iOS requires resume after gesture; startGame starts from click. Good.
4. Sound toggle when audio context suspended? On mobile, clicking start resumes. Sound toggle only adjusts gain.
5. Rage gain: 11 per hit, 10 hits to full; with many kills boss hits (6) + kill bonus? damageEnemy adds rage per hit; kill doesn't add extra. Fine. Rage burst damage 95 to all in 270. Strong.
6. Boss phase adds spawn as regular draugr and bossPhase prevents repeat. Good.
7. After boss dies, mode stays play for 1.8s while boss corpse removed; boss bar gone; "EL BOSQUE RESPIRA" message. Good.
8. During that 1.8s, `cleared` stays false but round=3 so no transition. Good.
9. Win overlay after setTimeout; if player paused during the 1.8s, mode='pause', guard mode==='play' prevents win! Bug: boss dies, timer triggers endGame only if mode==='play'. If player pauses in that window, victory never shows. Fix by using a `pendingWin` state or check mode==='play'||'pause'. Or set mode='victory-pending'. Simplest: guard `if(mode!=='dead'&&mode!=='win'){endGame(true)}`. If paused, endGame sets mode win and overlay; pause label might still show. endGame should remove pause label and hide it. Add ui.pause.classList.remove('show') in endGame. Better.
10. If player dies while boss death timer pending, mode dead → guard prevents win. Good.
11. On restart, setTimeout from previous game could fire? The timeout captures nothing; endGame(true) could fire during new game if user restarts within 1.8s? Only after boss death, overlay is from win at 1.8s; user can't restart before overlay appears unless paused. If paused, they'd restart? No overlay hidden until win. Edge case minor. Add a game id? not needed.
12. If the player wins and presses Enter quickly, startGame sets mode play; an old timeout? It already fired to show win. Fine.

Fix guard + pause label.

13. If player dies, `mode='dead'`, update stops; particles freeze. Overlay shows immediately. Could add death animation delay? Maybe not.

14. Touch attack hold: after game over, keys.touchAttack may stay true if pointerup happened? Button hidden by menu-open, pointerup might not fire → stuck true. On restart, holding? keys.touchAttack could remain true and auto-attack forever. To be safe, clear keys in startGame. `keys={}`. Add. Similarly touchAttack. Add `keys={}` in initWorld.

15. Start overlay button click while mode menu; startGame. Enter works. On win, Enter starts new game. Good.

16. `initWorld` resets arrays including embers; snow gap? okay.

17. Canvas scaling: game is 960x540 internal; CSS stretches to shell 16:9. Good.

18. Device pixel ratio: canvas fixed 960x540; on 1200x675 slightly upscaled (1.25x) → okay. On 4K could be blurry, but acceptable. Could set canvas to DPR scaling, but coordinates rely on W/H. devicePixelRatio scaling would improve crispness: set canvas width=W*dpr and ctx.scale(dpr,dpr). But all drawing uses W,H and canvas CSS width; if we scale, need maintain. Could implement on load: `const dpr=Math.min(2,devicePixelRatio||1); canvas.width=W*dpr; canvas.height=H*dpr; ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)`. Then all drawing coordinate space W,H. Screenshots would be sharper. But current is 960x540 stretched to 1200x675 → 1.25x, slightly soft; with dpr 2 in headless? devicePixelRatio=1. So no improvement. On phones DPR 3 → 960*3=2880 render expensive. Cap 2. Good improvement. But ctx.setTransform resets each frame? draw() uses ctx.save/restore, clearRect(0,0,W,H) in scaled space. If we setTransform once, save/restore preserve scaling. Fine. However canvas screenshot at 1200 shows internal 960 stretched 1.25; fine.

I'll skip DPR to keep performance safe on mobile.

19. Font loading. Fine.

20. Accessibility: audio toggle, pause. Good.

21. The rotate gate on desktop narrow portrait. Fine.

22. Safe area top? notch on iPhone landscape is left/right; shell 693 centered → content away from notch; good. Touch buttons inside shell with 12px padding, could still be under notch? The shell is centered with margins from viewport edges (75px), so safe.

23. On tablets portrait 768x1024, gate displays due to pointer coarse? If actual tablet yes. If desktop at 768x1024 (fine pointer), media max-width:700 false, pointer coarse false → gate hidden, game shell width=min(768,1024*1.777=1820)=768, height=432, HUD desktop, overlay content height ~400 fits 432. Playable. Fine.

24. Landscape phone overlay compact has sound button at top right visible; pause hidden via menu-open. Good.

25. Touch UI shown only `(pointer:coarse)`. Some tablets with trackpads report fine? Usually coarse. Good.

26. On touch, the pause/sound buttons are 26px on mobile, smaller than 44 recommended. Increase to 34px for touch. Media max-height sets 26. Set 32x32 with top 54 and right 12; pause right 54. Keep. Actually topbar occupies 12-50; buttons at 54-86; HUD at 58 left only. Fine. Make 32.

27. On coarse, `.touch-btn` 44; labels tiny 8px. Fine.

Let's apply fixes.

Also add footstep dust. Not necessary.

Let me fix endGame pause + keys reset + touch button sizes.

Specificity: `.sound-btn.pause-btn{right:52px}` inside media (0,2,0) beats base (0,2,0) later in file? Media appears later than base, so right:52 applies. Good.

Now test desktop full gameplay with new visuals, boss, and ensure no errors. Resize to 1200x675.

Also check the score/combo UI. Let me run a scripted test where I get to boss and screenshot mid-fight with shockwaves. Use debug (still present). For the shot, set wave3, position player? Could wait ~3s and screenshot multiple times until shockwave. Take 2-3 in sequence but only read latest. Let's just wait for boss attack.

First desktop screenshot start + fight. Then boss. Also check pause overlay and mute button.

Let me resize 1200x675, reload, start, screenshot initial gameplay after 1s. Then wave3 + wait 4s + screenshot.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D Norse/God of War–style action game with Ragnarök-inspired music and theme, in the existing PlayGround repo.
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly at completion.

## Requirements
- Complete playable game now, not a mockup.
- 2D action style inspired by God of War; Ragnarök/Norse music and atmosphere.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (max 1280px wide) for self-checks; read only latest relevant screenshot.
- Support mobile touch controls and responsive layouts.

## Decisions
- Single-file static game at `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html` using HTML/CSS/Canvas 2D.
- Procedural Web Audio music/sfx (drone, pad, wind, war drums, horn hits) — no external audio assets.
- Three-wave structure: 3 draugr, 4 draugr, then “El Vigía del Abismo” boss with telegraphed ice shockwaves and summoned adds at 50% HP.
- Player mechanics: A/D move, W jump, Space dodge, J hold-to-attack combo, K rage AoE, P/Esc pause, M mute.
- Mobile: touch controls, safe-area padding, landscape gate for portrait phones; retry/sound/pause controls.
- Visual style: stylized dark Norse forest, aurora, moon, ravens, braziers, rune circle, snow, fog, foreground grass, giant frost-giant boss.
- Used a temporary `window.__test`/`window.__dbg` harness for validation, then removed both; only a legitimate `console.warn` for unavailable audio remains.
- Working from git-tracked repo with all files currently untracked (no commit made).

## Work State
### Completed
- Full game built and visually iterated: menu, combat, 3 waves, boss, victory/defeat overlays, pause, mute, touch UI, portrait rotate gate.
- Verified menu at 1280×720 and 1024px preview, combat, boss fight, death screen, victory screen, mobile landscape, portrait gate.
- Verified touch attack button works (player.attack became >0 during test), pause toggling works, no console errors except expected favicon 404 earlier (favicon fixed).
- Improved HUD typography, bars, axe/enemy weapon silhouettes, enemy spacing, damage-number spread, brazier height, boss bar, shockwave visuals, low-HP vignette, red hurt flash.
- Removed all debug hooks and `spawnTimer`; syntax checks passed repeatedly.
- Final gameplay screenshot shows player + three enemies correctly grounded and spaced (verified with crop at `/tmp/opencode/crop-char.png`).

### Active
- Final visual/QA pass after HUD and weapon-handle color tweaks; latest screenshot `/tmp/opencode/game-hud.jpg` was taken before a final crop check.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Read latest screenshot `/tmp/opencode/crop-char.png` to confirm exactly 3 enemies and grounded feet; current crop shows player plus three enemies, all grounded.
2. Optionally take one final 1280×720 gameplay screenshot and a final 390×844 portrait screenshot; then stop the test server and conclude.
3. Give the user a concise Spanish completion summary: title, controls, features, assumptions (procedural music, landscape-first mobile), and where to play.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: complete game implementation; the only deliverable file.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: existing auto-generated project README; left untouched.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: platform default static server wrapper; serves root `index.html` per runtime `default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Test server currently running in tmux session `game-test` on `http://localhost:8000` (python http.server), started via `tmux new-session -d -s game-test 'python3 -m http.server 8000'`.
- Playwright browser is open in default session; an extra background python server from `shell` may also exist but tmux one works.
- Game canvas internal resolution is 960×540; CSS scales 16:9 shell. HUD/title use Cinzel + DM Sans from Google Fonts with fallbacks.
- Audio starts only on user gesture (`startGame` from click/Enter), and uses `AudioContext`/`webkitAudioContext`; mute respects gain in start/pause/end.
